fields.name: Developer of record
fields.value: Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. for the EEA and Switzerland)

fields.name: Licence
fields.value: Llama 3.1 Community License (custom open-weight licence), dated July 23, 2024

conditions: When distributing the model or a product using it, include a copy of the licence and show 'Built with Llama' (1.b.i)
If outputs are used to train or improve an AI model that is shared, that model's name must start with 'Llama' (1.b.i)
Keep the notice: 'Llama 3.1 is licensed under the Llama 3.1 Community License, Copyright © Meta Platforms, Inc. All Rights Reserved.' (1.b.iii)
Follow applicable laws and the Acceptable Use Policy, which is part of the licence (1.b.iv)
restrictions: Organizations with over 700 million monthly active users (as of July 23, 2024) must request a separate licence from Meta (Section 2)
No trademark rights except using 'Llama' as required above (5.a)
All licences end if you sue Meta claiming Llama or its outputs infringe your IP (5.c)
Meta can terminate the licence for any breach; you must then delete the model (Section 6)
Governed by California law, California courts (Section 7)
value.bank_note: Allowed for a bank (all Canadian banks are far below 700M users), but conditional: the Acceptable Use Policy bans unlicensed financial advice and discriminatory credit decisions, and customer letters must not be presented as written by a person. A vendor swapping in a Llama fine-tune brings these obligations with it.

fields.name: Base model
fields.value: Instruction-tuned version of the Llama 3.1 8B pretrained model (supervised fine-tuning and RLHF). Not a third-party fine-tune.

fields.name: Training data disclosure
fields.value: Partial. About 15 trillion tokens of publicly available online data (cutoff December 2023), plus public instruction datasets and over 25 million synthetic examples. Specific datasets and their licences are not disclosed.

fields.name: Permitted / prohibited uses
fields.value: Intended for commercial and research use in 8 supported languages. Out of scope: anything breaking laws or the Acceptable Use Policy, and use in unsupported languages. The Acceptable Use Policy bans unlicensed financial practice, discrimination in credit, collecting sensitive personal data without consent, fraud, and presenting outputs as human-written.

fields.name: Official documentation
fields.value: Yes: model card, evaluation details and the Llama 3 paper (arXiv 2407.21783)

fields.name: Disclosed risks
fields.value: Outputs may be inaccurate, biased or objectionable; testing could not cover all scenarios; developers must do their own safety testing; not designed to be deployed without system safeguards (Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard, Code Shield); safety only verified in the 8 supported languages.

fields.name: Audit contact
fields.value: Policy violations: LlamaUseReport@meta.com. Model issues: GitHub issues on meta-llama/llama-models. Risky outputs: developers.facebook.com/llama_output_feedback. Security: Meta bug bounty.
